stories.title: Girl’s family frustrated with ICBC, access to care, after she was hit by car
stories.summary: Makenna suffered a severe brain injury in May after a car hit her and a boy while they were on an e-scooter crossing the street at Hastings and Hythe Avenue in Burnaby.

stories.title: B.C. education changes: Restore letter grades, repeal SOGI, bring back O’Canada
stories.summary: Lynne Block was elected in 2026 as the MLA for North Vancouver-Seymour and has been appointed as the Minister of Education and Child Care.

stories.title: CFL awards 2028 Grey Cup to Edmonton
stories.summary: Edmonton will host the 2028 Grey Cup not because of financial considerations, but because of the city's history of hosting major events, the amazing turnaround of the Elks football team and support from the community.

stories.title: NHLers on staying patient in a rebuild
stories.summary: Ryan Strome and the Anaheim Ducks were on an upswing.

stories.title: Parts of B.C. Coast under orange-level rainfall warnings as final, potent storm hits
stories.summary: British Columbia's coast is getting another weather wallop as Environment Canada warns of rain of up to 225 millimetres along much of the coast before the end of the day.

stories.title: Salvation Army faces unprecedented demand in Okanagan as donations lag
stories.summary: The growing need is creating a double challenge for the Salvation Army, which is also struggling to find enough volunteers to help raise money.

stories.title: Doctor slams Island Health after woman dies outside closed emergency room
stories.summary: A shortage of emergency-trained nurses at Port Hardy Hospital is raising concerns, with one critic saying nurse managers should return to front-line care to help keep the ER open.

stories.title: Kelowna foster care village aims to tackle declining number of foster homes
stories.summary: A $15-million project is aiming to create a purpose-built community for foster kids, as high housing costs are making it difficult to place children.

stories.title: Court filing claims RCMP allegedly returned gun later used in Tumbler Ridge shooting
stories.summary: U.S. authorities have already released months of alleged online correspondence between James Cody Bryant and B.C. teenager Jesse Van Rootselaar.

stories.title: Coastal B.C. bracing for another fall storm as warnings issued, King Tides expected
stories.summary: Another frontal system is washing over coastal B.C., bringing heavy rains and strong winds, swelling waterways just as king tides peak this week.
